hero.title: Mother's Day Lunch
hero.lede: On Mothering Sunday we set the restaurant and the conservatory for family lunches, from a table for two to three generations together, and nobody has to do the washing up.

sections.title: Mother's Day at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
Mothering Sunday falls three weeks before Easter, so it moves about the calendar, but it is nearly always a Sunday in March. It began as the day people walked back to their mother church, and somewhere along the way it became the day we take our mothers out for lunch. That is what we do at Bentley Hotel.

Lunch is served in the restaurant and in the conservatory, the glass room on the side of the house where the light is good even on a grey March afternoon. We offer a set lunch for the day, cooked in our own kitchen in the Scottish and British way we cook the rest of the year, with a choice at each course. The menu, the sittings and the price are confirmed each season, and we’ll send them to you when you ask.

Tables range from two up to the whole family. If you’re bringing grandparents, aunts and cousins and need a long table or a room of your own, our function suite seats up to 100 and can be set for private dining. Tell us who is coming and we’ll find the right spot. If you’d like flowers or a cake brought to the table, say so when you book and we’ll arrange it quietly. And if anyone is travelling to be there, our 18 en-suite rooms are upstairs, parking is free and Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk.

sections.title: The room, the lunch and the night after

items.title: The conservatory
items.text: Our purpose-built conservatory is a bright room for a long Sunday lunch, and the restaurant beside it takes the larger tables. For a room of your own, ask about the function suite.

items.title: The lunch
items.text: A set Mother’s Day lunch from our own kitchen, Scottish and British cooking with a choice at each course. The menu and price are confirmed each season.

items.title: Make a weekend of it
items.text: Book a room for mum, or for the relatives who travelled, and have breakfast cooked to order the next morning. Check-in from 2pm, check-out by 11am.

sections.title: Mother's Day: what people ask us

items.q: How do we book a table for Mother's Day?
items.a: Call us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry with your numbers and the time you’d like to eat. We’ll confirm this year’s menu, sittings and price and hold your table. It is one of the busiest lunches of the year, so the earlier you book the better.

items.q: Do we need to pay a deposit?
items.a: For larger tables we may ask for a deposit to hold the booking. We’ll explain how much, when it is due and our cancellation terms when you book.

items.q: Can you cater for dietary requirements and for children?
items.a: Yes. Tell us about allergies, intolerances and vegetarian or vegan guests when you book and the kitchen will plan for them. Children are welcome in the restaurant; ask us about a smaller menu for them.

items.q: Is there parking, and can we come by train?
items.a: Parking at the hotel is free. Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk, with the fastest trains reaching Glasgow Central in under 20 minutes. If relatives are travelling a long way, book them a room and make a weekend of it.

sections.title: Book a table for Mother's Day
sections.text: Tell us how many are coming and when you’d like to eat, and we’ll hold your table. Rooms for the night can be booked online.
